findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "robotics-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: robotics-intelligence_protocol-compatibility-check · Private data: robotics-intelligence_rosbag-telemetry-parse, robotics-intelligence_workcell-performance-report · Public sink: robotics-intelligence_rosbag-telemetry-parse, robotics-intelligence_ros-topic-schema-diff, robotics-intelligence_telemetry-anomaly-detect, robotics-intelligence_cycle-time-analyze, robotics-intelligence_downtime-root-cause, robotics-intelligence_opcua-tag-map-normalize, robotics-intelligence_plc-alarm-cluster, robotics-intelligence_maintenance-interval-estimate, robotics-intelligence_protocol-compatibility-check, robotics-intelligence_workcell-performance-report · Destructive: robotics-intelligence_rosbag-telemetry-parse, robotics-intelligence_ros-topic-schema-diff, robotics-intelligence_telemetry-anomaly-detect, robotics-intelligence_cycle-time-analyze, robotics-intelligence_downtime-root-cause, robotics-intelligence_opcua-tag-map-normalize, robotics-intelligence_plc-alarm-cluster, robotics-intelligence_maintenance-interval-estimate, robotics-intelligence_protocol-compatibility-check, robotics-intelligence_workcell-performance-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
